Nerd Fonts 3.4.0 glyph source attribution

The bundled WOFF2 is JetBrains Mono 2.304 patched by Nerd Fonts 3.4.0.
The following copyright and licence metadata comes from its pinned glyph sources.
Additional full notices are in this directory and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt.
